temporal_observations.observation: Gold lamp stays rigid while its narrow reflection fractures and flickers across the water during camera pan, forward movement and bob. Unlit water is nearly black; faint floor detail remains.
Lamp/reflection track camera translation. Frames39-44 contain a rapid pitch/turn; reflection length changes with grazing view. No large geometric waves are visible.
Passing the rock pillar introduces red pickup-light reflections beside warm reflections. Shallow detail is visible; a rigid metal ledge enters at59-60.
Dry metal ledge remains rigid and sharply occludes the water. Warm bright bands and red cross reflections stretch and break into separate streaks on the surface.
80-84 show a dark occluded/grazing transition; the footage cannot uniquely establish underwater submersion.85-90 show red segmented reflections and a rise toward the dry ledge.
Approach to dry ledge and health pickup. Beginning at97, the pickup flash tints the entire image yellow; this is not a permanent water colour. Dry walls, box and ledge stay rigid.
Return toward water with receding gold reflection; global pickup tint fades. The reflection breaks into short moving highlights and stays aligned with environmental light.
As light leaves the reflection/view, water and passage are nearly black. There is no constant glowing blue/brown surface colour, foam or large wave displacement.

owner_clarification: RTX reference darkness is contextual cave illumination. Prioritise reflection-led surface definition and refracted underwater detail/light, with environment-dependent brightness/colour; no RTX equivalence claim.
